title: DesignDay Bangalore — Storytelling: Narratives in Indian Context
description:
The theme for this month's DesignDay is:

Storytelling is a powerful medium that enriches the design process across all creative platforms. A well-designed product tells a story of the designer, his rich experiences in wielding the ideas that go into the product and eventually creates new stories for the user. Most designers rely on their experiences related to the craft and the new and innovative ways in which people who use their product to creative meaning in their work. This DesignDay two amazingly talented speakers share their experiences of building narratives in Indian context.

DesignDay is a monthly event that brings together designers from multidisciplinary backgrounds to a common platform in order to interact and learn from each other.

The agenda includes:
1. An Inspiration Design Story by a well-experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of their career in design.
2. A Skill Building Session by a mid-career designer to teach us something new using real world examples and case studies.
3. A Jam by you and fellow participants (in groups) to come up with some design suggestions based on a given topic in 1.5 to 2 hours.
